summary: Tested public preview auth and the API end-to-end flow. Registration initially exposed a MongoDB ObjectId serialization 500; fixed and verified registration, workspace creation, preset publish, public submission, persistence, and protected endpoint behavior. Analytics average remains inconsistent with dashboard metrics.

minor.issue: Analytics average is calculated from only the first rating answer per response (5.0 for 5,5,4), while /api/dashboard/summary calculates all rating answers (4.7); metrics are inconsistent.

action_items: Align /api/analytics average calculation with dashboard rating semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Registration response previously included MongoDB _id and caused HTTP 500; fixed by excluding _id from the returned user payload.
seed_data_creation: Created unique test owner/workspace/template/response records via public preview API and one UI registration account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Registration, protected owner access, preset publish, public anonymous response, response persistence, and mobile auth/onboarding were exercised. Recheck analytics averages after aligning semantics; full browser publish UI was not repeated because equivalent API flow was covered.
rca of the issue: POST /api/auth/register inserted a Mongo document then returned the raw user dict, including ObjectId _id; FastAPI JSON encoding failed with 500. Excluding _id fixes the serialization path. /api/analytics breaks after the first numeric rating in each response, whereas dashboard iterates every rating answer, causing divergent averages.
